scanned.actualMeaning: todayRows.length after upstream Formal normalization/filtering; not raw exchange listing count

with60Days.actualMeaning: featureRows with historyDays>=60; under V8.12 featureRows are already history-admission gated before this selector
with60Days.caveat: Do not infer V8.12 rejected-history count from scanned-with60Days alone; use historySourceRevalidation diagnostics.

baseEligible.actualMeaning: count where scoreCandidate returned basePassed=true. This means the symbol passed early gates through chip-concentration and reached the downstream precision-screen phase; it may still fail financial completeness/event/valuation/sector/A-B/fundamental/volatility/target/RR/signal-grade gates.

rrEligible.actualMeaning: count where scoreCandidate returned rrPassed=true. This requires all preceding downstream gates and a verifiable target plus RR>=MIN_REWARD_RISK; a row may still fail final B-grade setup-quality gate.

channelCounts.actualMeaning: A/B counts only among result.ok=true scored candidates after all Formal scoreCandidate gates including final B-grade quality

exclusions.actualMeaning: fail-fast first rejection reason across all featureRows processed by scoreCandidate
exclusions.prohibitedInterpretation: Not independent gate failures, not marginal contribution, not expected recovered candidates if a gate is relaxed.

conditionDistribution.actualMeaning: Recomputed A/B check states inside the early-base-admitted cohort, including rows that Formal may already have rejected at financial/event/valuation/sector gates before reaching setup evaluation.
conditionDistribution.prohibitedInterpretation: Not a sequential Formal funnel stage and not an admission counterfactual.

thousandPool.actualMeaning: Recomputed THOUSAND subset diagnostics using the same scoreCandidate gates.
thousandPool.overlap: Top-level diagnostics already include THOUSAND rows because the first featureRows loop covers both pools.
thousandPool.prohibitedInterpretation: Do not add top-level counts to thousandStockPool counts; that double-counts thousand symbols.
thousandPool.safeDerivation: GENERAL-only stage counts may be derived as top-level minus thousand subset only when same-date deterministic scoring/completeness is proven.

invariants: Within the same featureRows evaluation, fullyQualified <= rrEligible <= baseEligible <= featureRows.
Sum(firstFailure counts) + fullyQualified should equal evaluated featureRows, subject to explicit source/data-admission exclusions occurring before scoreCandidate.
Top-level stage counts include GENERAL and THOUSAND; thousand-specific stage counts are a subset, not an additional pool to sum.
ConditionDistribution denominator is basePassed cohort, not all scanned rows and not only rows that actually reached the A/B gate in fail-fast order.

researchUsage.candidateScarcity: Use stage transitions with exact denominators; do not compare raw counters with incompatible denominators.
researchUsage.gateRelaxation: Requires gate-overlap/ablation receipts, not exclusion counts.
researchUsage.quotaResearch: Use complete per-pool qualified ranks, not top-level base/rr counters.
researchUsage.historyDataQuality: Use V8.12 historySourceRevalidation diagnostics for pre-feature missingness.
